image_description: A guenon monkey (likely a Diana monkey or similar species) sitting on a large rock in front of a tree trunk. The monkey has dark grey/black fur on its back and limbs, a white chest and throat, and golden-yellow flanks. It features a distinctive white brow band and facial ruff. The tail is long and hangs down behind the rock.
